result:
The verdict is **fix**: the [Tasks page](/framework/ai/tasks/) itself is right at all four widths, but nothing keeps its numbers fresh. No part of the dev server or Servex starts `Server/TaskState.mjs --watch`. The readme says the dev server does, and that the page warns when its data is old; neither is true. Without that watcher running, the minute counts and ⚠ marks freeze where they were.

One more caveat: the Lanes tab and clicking a row were not in the screenshots, so I checked those from the code only.

The full report is in [report.md](review/report.md), in the task folder.
